colombia-maraton-2008.notes: The page shows nine problem entries (A-E, then B-E again) while the pack knows five (A-E). The B-E group (Frieze Patterns, GATTACA, 9 Puzzle, Batman) may belong to another contest on the same judge page. A table of problems A-J (Arrange the Numbers ... Just Another Problem) with problemsetters is present only inside an HTML comment and is not described. The page date (October 1, 2008) differs from the pack's 2008-09-20 and is not stated to be the contest day.
